0022600030.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-7, 15th in the East) host the Toronto Raptors (4-4, 5th in the East) in their ninth game of the 2026-27 season, an Emirates NBA Cup East Group A matchup, with Milwaukee on a four-game losing streak and 1-3 at home. Kam Jones is out for the Bucks with an ankle injury, while Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture) are out for Toronto. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Bucks lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 122-94 Toronto win in Milwaukee on February 22, 2026.
